zh-CN.title: 玄奘回到长安
zh-CN.subtitle: 旅行经验进入译经制度的转折点
zh-CN.shortSummary: 玄奘回到长安后，求法旅行被转化为译经、讲学和寺院制度中的长期工作。
curatorialDescription: 时间轴把“回到长安”作为路线与城市制度相接的节点，而不是把它当作传奇旅程的终点。
zh-CN.researchNote: 需要核对具体年份、入城路线、译经项目起止和不同传记版本之间的差异。

value.en: Return from pilgrimage and institutional transition

en.title: Xuanzang returns to Chang'an
en.subtitle: A turning point from travel to translation institutions
en.shortSummary: After Xuanzang returned to Chang'an, pilgrimage experience became long-term work in translation, teaching and monastic institutions.
curatorialDescription: The timeline treats the return as the point where route and urban institutions meet, rather than the endpoint of a legend.
en.researchNote: Exact year, arrival route, translation projects and differences among biographical versions still need verification.

value.en: Return from pilgrimage and institutional transition
